triage.classification: Value-range-preserving integer promotion; no unsafe narrowing or production defect found.
triage.reasoning: Each conditional chooses either an int8_t RSSI field/parameter or integer zero. C promotes the conditional to int, but its result is always in [-128,127]. Assigning/passing it back to int8_t is representable and defined. Frozen network_status.h, native_state.h/.c and actual callback/WS code establish the field and parameter types. No cast, suppression or source rewrite is needed.

triage.classification: Nonblocking representation-portability caveat retained; no unsafe access, incorrect payload or new high-risk defect reproduced.
triage.reasoning: The three added boolean flags introduce padding in the private ws_status_key_t. capture_status explicitly memset-zeroes the whole key before member population, and both previous/current objects have static storage; it then compares and copies them only in HTTPD owner context. This is not an uninitialized automatic struct or a credentials comparison. A portable C language guarantee that struct assignment preserves every padding byte is still absent: unusual compiler treatment could cause unnecessary status revisions/sends. This warning is not relabeled universally harmless or a memory-safety bug. Existing actual WS schedules cover unchanged suppression/heartbeat and all network validity changes; no new entire suite or cosmetic layout edit was requested.

limits: All warnings and analyzer traces are retained. AST analysis does not prove concurrency/hardware behavior; actual-loop behavioral campaigns remain separate. No optimized Clang code generation was attempted because the prior time_settings_valid compiler crash remains a distinct known tool issue. No source warning suppression or cosmetic rewrite. The deferred AAC private owner-view issue was not retried or bypassed; C3/shared production sources are unchanged and no full C3 rerun was performed.
